text:
Dear Paperkite Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Frontend Developer role at Paperkite. With a background in interaction design and hands-on experience building fast, accessible web applications, I was drawn to your team and the work you do.

As a frontend developer, I enjoy turning Figma designs into clean, reusable React components and robust code. In my recent freelance work, I built seven marketing websites for small businesses using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, and every single one of them scores 95+ on Lighthouse. I also have experience connecting web applications to external data sources, such as building a café menu page that reads items directly from a Google Sheet. Additionally, I built my personal portfolio using Astro and deployed it on Netlify, giving me practical familiarity with the tools and workflows your team values. 

My education with a B.Des in Interaction Design from Lakeside School of Design further grounds my approach in creating intuitive user experiences. I would love the opportunity to bring my skills in Next.js, Astro, and Figma to Paperkite and contribute to your upcoming projects. 

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your needs.

Warmly,

Alex Rao
